name: barry75
caption:
1975 🎮🏀 Washington won 60 games. We won 48. We swept them.

• 1975 Finals: our 48-34 team vs the 60-22 Bullets
• We sweep 4-0, our first title since 1956
• Rick Barry: Finals MVP, shooting his free throws underhand
• Barry's NBA career free throws: 90%
• Steph today: 98.5% from the line through 8 games

Best free throw shooter we've ever had: Barry or Steph? 👇

beats.head: 1975 FINALS
beats.name: UNDERDOGS
beats.vo: Washington wins sixty games. We win forty-eight. Everybody picks them.

beats.head: THE SWEEP
beats.name: BULLETS
beats.vo: We sweep them. Four games to none. Our first title since nineteen fifty-six.

beats.head: FINALS MVP
beats.name: RICK BARRY
beats.vo: Rick Barry is Finals MVP. And he shoots his free throws underhanded... at ninety percent for his NBA career.
beats.dlg: RICK BARRY: FINALS MVP.|UNDERHAND FREE THROWS!

beats.head: AT THE LINE NOW
beats.name: STEPH
beats.vo: Half a century later, Steph is shooting ninety-eight point five percent from the line through eight games.

beats.head: BARRY OR STEPH?
beats.vo: Best free throw shooter we've ever had: Barry or Steph? Comment below.

facts.claim: 1975 NBA Finals: underdog Warriors (48–34) swept the Washington Bullets (60–22) 4–0, their first championship since 1956; Rick Barry Finals MVP
Rick Barry, Hall of Famer, underhand free throws; NBA career free throw percentage .900 (90%); 1975 Finals MVP
